_about: Morning mist (asagiri) lying low over the water and the rice paddies at dawn (MistRules; the 3D view's MistLayer, the flat view's MistView). Outdoor maps only: none in rooms, under a roof or in the mine. `sources`: which ground makes mist: a map's tiles of `water` and `paddy` (the farm: its pond's cells, as water). `curve` [[hour, density], ...] on the game clock, eased (smoothstep) between keys and 0 outside them: it gathers before first light, lies thickest from 5:00 to 6:30 and burns off by 8:00. `seasons`: the share each kind of ground makes in each season (spring and fall the most, summer a little; in winter the paddies lie frozen or dry, so only the open water steams). `looks`: the share under each weather look of data/weather_fx.json (none in a storm or a blizzard, thin in rain, some over the open water on a snowy winter morning). `wind_thin`: the wind of data/wind.json thins it, the share times 1 - wind_thin x the wind (a sunny breeze 0.15 keeps about nine tenths, rain's 0.5 about seven tenths). The mist is drawn as soft low sheets: `per_cell` sheets for each source cell, at least 1 and at most `max`; each lives `life` seconds (varied by `life_var`), fading in and out, its home a source cell (moved by up to `jitter` cells), fading out toward the map's edge, drifting along `wind_dir` at `drift` + `drift_wind` x the wind (cells a second) with a slow sideways `wobble`; `size` [min, max] cells long along the wind and `across` times that wide, swelling by `swell` over its life; `height` [min, max] cells above the ground, bobbing `bob`; over the paddies `paddy_height` by season instead, so it lies over the rice's tips (low over the young spring rice, about knee-high over the tall summer and fall rice, which would hide it lower down). `alpha`: a sheet's most alpha at full density (low: they overlap). `color`: the mist's own colour, taken toward the hue of the sky (Game.sky_color, made bright) by `sky_share`, so it reads lavender before sunrise and peach as the sun comes up; the day / night tint lies over it as over everything. `flat`: the flat view, where a sheet is drawn from above as `rings` stepped ellipses (whole pixels, no blur), each `ring_alpha` of the sheet's, `height_px` pixels a cell of height lifts it up the screen. Balance numbers are ours.
